(Harden single-handedly won 2 games for Philly against Boston in 2023. If Embiid does the same, they win the series. Other GOAT candidate won all of his titles within 3 years of changing teams at free agency. You see the problem ? No one in the history of this sport has had all the pressure and just consistently showed up, so why would you expect that of Harden ?
